ValidationRule.description: Sales Leadership would like to require a Loss Reason on Closed Lost --TLP 6/27/23
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed Lost'), ISBLANK(TEXT( Loss_Reason__c )), (RecordType.Name = 'CPQ') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If you lose an Opportunity, the Loss Reason is required.
